source.title: Layout
source.description: `Layout` splits the terminal into rows and columns of independent content, usable with `Live` for full-screen apps; for example fixed or proportional sizes, hiding parts.

source.title: Panel
source.description: Draw a border around text or any renderable, with a box style, a title or subtitle, and width fitted to the content.

source.title: Styles
source.description: Controls how text looks, such as colors, bold, underline and links, via style strings or `Style` objects; `Theme` names styles and overrides Rich's defaults.

source.title: Console API
source.description: The `Console` object controls how and where all output is written; for example logging, spinners, test capture, HTML/SVG export, paging, and color in CI.

source.title: Padding
source.description: Add blank space around text or any renderable, set per side like CSS padding, with an optional background color.

source.title: Tables
source.description: Everything about `Table`, from borders, headers and column widths to alignment and row striping; `Table.grid` also places content side by side without borders.
